reader_semantics.training_responses: The model was trained on responses from ground-truth instances; this read serves the same calls from frozen mask proposals selected among the capture's cached phrases.
reader_semantics.universe_rule: Both arms use the normalized phrases in the current capture's frozen mask cache.
